title: A resume that continues an open pull request merged it without adding the new integration line to its body
resolution: Before the merge, a resume reads the open pull request body with gh pr view and appends the new line with gh pr edit, keeping the earlier text and lines; spec, design, protocol, and a fail-before test follow

title: The archive check matched any directory ending in the branch name while the change name needed the dated pattern, so a mismatch exited 1 without a marker
resolution: The check and the change name share the dated pattern archive/YYYY-MM-DD-<branch>, so a mismatch prints NOT ARCHIVED and exits 5; a test fails before the fix

title: record_integration silently set the global integration_line that later steps read
resolution: format_integration_line builds the line, which the caller assigns, and record_integration only prints it and appends the JSON record

title: No test showed that a failed gh pr view or gh pr edit on resume stops before gh pr merge
resolution: The gh stub fails pr edit under FAKE_EDIT=fail and a test expects a non-zero exit with no pr merge call; it covers existing behavior and passes before the fix

title: The proposal and task 2.3 did not mention appending the line to an open pull request on resume
resolution: The proposal bullet and task 2.3 name the resume append

title: verification.md gave 395 characters for the requirement body, which the pass 1 fix grew to 457
resolution: The spec bullet records both counts, 395 before and 457 after the pass 1 fix
